desc: Implement modular exponentiation for computing (m-1)^(n-1-k) mod 10^9+7.
Implement a function to compute nCr mod 10^9+7 using precomputed factorials or direct computation with modular inverse.
Handle edge cases: if m == 1 and k != n-1, return 0; if m == 1 and k == n-1, return 1.
Compute the combination C(n-1, k) modulo 10^9+7.
Compute the final result as (C(n-1, k) * m % MOD * pow(m-1, n-1-k, MOD)) % MOD.
